CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artist_profile_drafts (artist_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,base_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artist_follows (user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,artist_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,email_updates INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,language VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,artist_id),INDEX artist_follow_cursor(artist_id,user_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artist_notifications (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,artist_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,mail_id VARCHAR(64),is_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY artist_notification_once(user_id,product_id),INDEX artist_notification_user(user_id,created_at),INDEX artist_notification_mail(mail_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artist_releases (product_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,artist_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,cursor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX artist_release_pending(status,created_at))
INSERT IGNORE INTO artist_releases SELECT id,artist_id,'','done',created_at FROM products WHERE status='active'
